thread:
olivia: sales asked for an observability feature: per-route + per-tenant cost breakdown in Console, with trace links for audit. timeline: they want a pilot in ~6 weeks.

kevin: two dims: (A) how we collect attribution data (cheap vs high-fidelity) and (B) how we surface it (aggr dashboards vs live drilldowns). need to propose MVP.

marta: collection idea: add stable `route_id` + `tenant_id` to span tags and expose a `token_estimate` per request. that lets us prorate batched calls. low runtime cost.

drew: surfacing idea: MVP = daily aggregated table (currency) + a "View samples" link that shows sampled traces for that route/day. avoid full per-request indexing.

sophie: customers asked for per-region and per-model splits too. can we include region and model_id as optional dimensions? add as tags but don't index by default.

olivia: suggested sampling policy: index all error traces + p95+ latency traces + 0.1% uniform sample otherwise. keeps trace volume bounded.

kevin: operational concerns: indexing more traces could blow our trace storage for midsize customers. propose opt-in for full indexing with quota caps. default to hybrid sampling.

marta: privacy/PII: trace link for billing must not expose customer PII. we'll redact user-provided fields in sampled trace views and document that.

drew: launch success criteria draft: 1) Console shows per-route daily currency cost and 7-day sparkline, 2) CSV export per-route/day, 3) "View samples" opens a sampled traces list filtered by route, 4) spans include `route_id`+`tenant_id`+`token_estimate`, 5) sampling config default set to hybrid, 6) docs + billing explanation, 7) beta with three customers.

kevin: delivery plan: week1 header propagation + token_estimate counters + opt-in flag; week2 sampling + pre-agg pipeline; week3 dashboard widgets + CSV export; week4 beta + iterate.

sophie: finance: show currency as default. add an optional breakdown by unit (token) for engineering. also record whether values are "estimated" vs "reconciled".

olivia: open tradeoffs we discussed: - fidelity vs cost (full indexing expensive), - realtime vs daily (daily cheaper), - customer trust on batching heuristics (need docs + dispute flow).

kevin: mitigation: expose attribution method in UI and include a "request audit" for customers to request raw events for a narrow window when disputes arise. opt-in only.

marta: UX note: include a small badge on dashboard rows that says "estimated" when using heuristic attribution.

drew: deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for config `telemetry.sampling=hybrid-0.1-error-p95` at 2024-06-02T03:00Z.

deploy-bot: queued deploy to staging: telemetry.sampling=hybrid-0.1-error-p95.

olivia: action items:
- kevin: RFC for header/tags + token_estimate (this week)
- marta: sampling config + storage impact estimate (this week)
- drew: dashboard mocks + CSV UX (48h)
- sophie: finance mapping for currency rates + reconcile job spec (this week)
- olivia: customer pilot invite list + QA checklist (today)

kevin: recommend we treat this as a customer-driven small sprint (4 engineers + 1 designer + analytics) and gate full rollout on reconciliation accuracy and storage signals. planning sync Friday 9am PT.
